name: VOT2014
description: An evaluation suite and challenge that measures single-object tracking performance on the VOT2014 dataset and benchmark sequences.
evaluation_method: tracking metrics: accuracy (average overlap), robustness (failure rate), and Expected Average Overlap (EAO)
typical_sota_score: ≈0.3–0.6 (EAO) for modern top trackers; older top methods typically around 0.3–0.4
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; relatively small evaluation set (on the order of a few dozen sequences) so results can be sensitive to evaluation protocol and initialization; the VOT challenge and metrics have evolved over time and some aspects may be saturated by modern trackers.
